reviews.x: I have thick, curly hair. I tend to blow dry it out for smoothness. Unfortunately, as I have aged, my hair has grown drier and harder to keep smooth, especially with the grey appearing. This is a lighter conditioner. I tend to choose a thicker type with coconut or keratin to moisturize it more.  This comes in a large pump style bottle. reviews.t: So this has a great scent, but I'm not in love with this ...
reviews.x: So this has a great scent, but I'm not in love with this conditioner.  I like when I put a conditioner in my hair and it helps my finger to glide through and I just don't feel like this does that...it's nice but I like my hair to feel soft when the conditioner is in (if that makes sense) and I just don't get that feeling with this...I also felt like it was a little too heavy for my hair but I will keep using it to see if, as I adjust the amount, it helps cut back on that heavy feeling.

reviews.t: Waste of $. Don't purchase
reviews.x: I rarely write reviews but had to for this one. This conditioner is NOT conditioning whatsoever. Did someone fill the bottle up with hand lotion? Cause that's what it feels like. Total waste of $. Also says it has coconut oil etc but none of the oils listed on the front of the bottle are in the ingredients. Also does not smell good at all.

reviews.t: Like the shampoo; not thrilled w the conditioner.
reviews.x: Really enjoy the shampoo but the conditioner doesn't offer a silky feeling upon rinsing out my hair. It has almost a wax, grippy like feel, when I squeeze water out if my hair when rinsing. The bottle size has lasted me a full year(shoulder length hair).

reviews.t: Missing Ingredients on label ?
reviews.x: Like others have said this does work well for my hair. I get lots of tangles and this did help. Smells nice, not too overpowering . Left my hair soft. However labeling is very deceptive and misleading.

reviews.t: SMELL'S BAD
reviews.x: This product smells bad!  I added lavender oil to it so I can not return the product.  It's as if the product was on the shelf too long...

reviews.t: This is the best conditioner! My hair was so dry and brittle
reviews.x: This is the best conditioner!  My hair was so dry and brittle. I would constantly mess with my hair, driving myself nuts because I was so self conscious about my dry hair. I could feel the difference with the first wash! It felt healthier and smoother. Im so glad I found it. Love this stuff.

I also have virgin hair that has no color or chemical damage to it. I use this as a deep conditioner. First off, this smells amazing! I love this conditioner! reviews.t: Review For Ethnic Hair
reviews.x: My mother (African American) uses this product for deep conditioning. Our tap water has a lot of minerals which can make your hair difficult to manage. But after using this conditioner along with the shampoo (Keeva Sulfate Free Shampoo with Tea Tree Oil), she has seen a great difference. Here hair is no longer super dry and difficult to comb. Because she wears her hair natural she can actually style her hair without excessive heat. This has been one of the better products she has used so far.

reviews.t: I love this shampoo and conditioner set
reviews.x: I love this shampoo and conditioner set! My hair has never felt so moisturized and healthy! I will never go back to any other set. I previously used pureology, and in comparison to this product i feel it works better, smells better and is more friendly on your wallet!

reviews.t: Keeva, take me away!
reviews.x: Nice large bottle of conditioner.  Very thick, and can be thinned with water a bit if you want to extend the life of the product.  While I am not overly fond of the scent (reason for the 4 stars) the conditioner itself works very well.  As I had said, it's a nice thick cream conditioner.  Goes on lightly. reviews.t: Thick, great conditioner, and lots of it - the bottle is very generously sized
reviews.x: The best thing about this conditioner is that it actually does the job of deep conditioning. There is a noticeable difference in my hair since starting to use it. In the winter, it gets dry and brittle, and this conditioner helps it be soft and smooth, especially the ends. I have a lot of fine blonde hair, and suffer from frizz, and this helps calm that frizz down without weighing down the hair. It has a very mild smell, which I appreciate. Smells a little bit like coconut and vanilla I think.

It has other ingredients besides essential oils in it but it sounds like this is an all-natural product, so I trust those ingredients are healthy also. reviews.t: Try it, you'll love it!
reviews.x: Love this conditioner and shampoo! Feels great on head and hair and you only need a little. Can get it a little cheaper on other sites but since I'm prime with free shipping and quick arrival comes out to about the same price.

reviews.t: Great conditioner
reviews.x: I love how it  leaves my hair so soft and lustrous.

reviews.t: Has Argan Oil, Tea Tree Oil, and Coconut Oil added
reviews.x: My hair is loving this Keeva Conditioner.  This bottle is large, and comes with an easy to use pump, which I love!  This conditioner helps tame my hair from frizz, which is difficult because there is a lot of humidity where I live.  I have noticed my hair has been a bit smoother since using this.  I love the smell of it, and my hair does feel deep conditioned for sure! I appreciate that this conditioner has a few natural ingredients added to it, such as Argan Oil, Tee Tree Oil, and Coconut Oil.

claims.text: Several reviewers question the ingredient labeling, saying listed oils or natural ingredients are not actually in the product or are missing from the label.
A common complaint is an unpleasant or rancid smell, or that the product received differs in scent from what was expected.
Many reviewers find the conditioner does not leave hair soft or smooth, describing frizz, a waxy/grippy feel, or no conditioning effect.
Some reviewers praise the scent and say it left their hair soft, smoother, or healthier.
A few reviewers report poor customer service or difficulty reaching support about product issues.
